title: Does deferoxamine reduce bone aluminum in dialysis patients?

grade.title: Small, uncontrolled, or single-source human evidence
grade.basis: One small case series and one randomized dose comparison without placebo.

answerHtml: In a case series, bone aluminum was absent or reduced in 3 dialysis patients who had a repeat biopsy after deferoxamine. A later randomized comparison of two doses, without placebo, found similar response rates at the low dose and the standard dose. These studies do not establish a population benefit beyond aluminum overload in dialysis.

sections.heading: Studies
sections.html:
• Malluche 1984: uncontrolled series, 7 treated dialysis patients, repeat biopsy in 3. Bone aluminum absent or reduced in those 3. The serum-rise test was not diagnostic. PMID 6377067.
  • Kan 2010: 21 versus 21 hemodialysis patients with aluminum overload. Success in 13 of 21 on the low dose and 12 of 21 on the standard dose, P=0.75. No placebo. doi:10.1093/ndt/gfp649. PMID 19948879.
